summary.result: The results by kriging technique approached by geostatistical method could reflect spatial characteristics of regional rainfall properly in Imha basin.
summary.background: In this study, spatial characteristics of rainfall in Imha basin were investigated by cross-correlation analysis among rainfall gaging stations and rainfall-runoff analysis used in HEC-HMS model for analysis of influence on observed rainfall.
summary.method: Their results are compared to rainfall-runoff data with spatially distributed rainfall data as well as the classical thiessen method.
